question.worked_solution:
The given set contains the roots $q\in Q$ of some quadratic polynomial $p(q).$

Since the quadratic polynomial has roots ${q}_{1}=-\frac{1}{2}$ and ${q}_{2}=3,$ and the coefficient of the quadratic term is $a=4,$ we can write the polynomial as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}p(q) & =a(q-{q}_{1})(q-{q}_{2}) \\  & =4\cdot (q-(-\frac{1}{2}))(q-3) \\  & =4(q+\frac{1}{2})(q-3) \\  & =4({q}^{2}-\frac{5q}{2}-\frac{3}{2}) \\  & =4{q}^{2}-10q-6\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, we can express the given set as follows:

$$
\{-\frac{1}{2},3\}=\{q\in Q\,:\,4{q}^{2}-10q-6=0\}
$$
